routes.title: The latest published sheets
routes.intro: Each sheet says whether the road is clear, to verify or reported broken, with the date of the last try.

latest.newsletter: Every week, the best sheets, discussions and articles.

routes.toVerify: The last check is old, one try is enough.
routes.broken: Open potholes, to fix before use.

signup.text: Share what you learned in production.

routes.title: Code that works, already tested by others
routes.body: Each sheet targets one service, country and stack. It gives the code, the known traps and the date of the last try. Once two developers have checked it, the road is clear.

screen.label: An itinerary sheet going from to verify to clear road

Checked by awa in Senegal, then by kofi in Côte d'Ivoire.

track.title: Replay the cases that break in production
track.body: Create a test key and call a simulated operator like the real one. Successful payment, insufficient balance, duplicate or late webhook, timeout, with no merchant account.

screen.title: Test key scenarios
screen.label: The Simulator scenarios played one after the other

relay.title: Webhooks reach your machine
relay.body: One command opens an outgoing connection to Overpass and replays every webhook on your development server, body and headers intact. No tunnel, no public address.

screen.title: Terminal
screen.label: The overpass-cli command receives webhooks and replays them on localhost

lines.text: Ready for wave, key ovp_test_Xk3f. Webhooks are passed to http://localhost:3000/webhook. Ctrl+C to stop.

mcp.title: Your code assistant reads the verified sheets
mcp.body: Plug the Overpass MCP server into Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code with a personal token. The assistant finds the sheet, reads its traps, then writes the integration that works.

screen.label: A code assistant using Overpass sheets

discussions.title: Ask the question, the answer can become a sheet
discussions.body: Integrations, cloud, tools and AI, career, projects or events. The author accepts the best answer, and a working solution turns into an itinerary sheet.

screen.title: Integration discussions
screen.label: A question that gets an accepted answer then becomes a sheet

thread.question: 401 error on the Orange Money webhook, any idea?
thread.answer: The token expires after one hour, renew it before the call.
thread.accepted: Accepted answer, 12 developers found it useful
thread.route: Now the sheet “Orange Money, renew the token”

blog.title: Every member has a blog
blog.body: Tutorials, field notes and tech news, with images and a cover. Follow authors, comment, give a star to useful articles. Every week, the newsletter sums up the best.

ranking.title: Every contribution counts
ranking.body: Publishing a sheet, checking one, confirming a trap, answering usefully or writing an article earns points. The ranking shows the developers and countries moving integrations forward.

requests.title: An API is missing? Propose it
requests.body: Propose a service missing from the catalogue, Overpass validates it. Vote for the next simulator, the Simulator adds the most requested services first.
